subject: Personnel integrity logbook transfer — SOC 2 evidence request
messages:
From: Jen Sullivan <jen.sullivan@finbank.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: trust-assure@compliance-consulting.com
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: consolidated personnel evidence for SOC 2 sample window

Hi David,

Thanks again for taking my call earlier. As part of FinBank's vendor SOC 2 sampling this quarter, our auditor (TrustAssure) has asked for a consolidated 'personnel integrity log' for the sample window Jul 2024–Sep 2025. Specifically they want:

- training completion records (security & privacy) with timestamps,
- redacted background check confirmations (date + pass/fail),
- onboarding/offboarding access change logs tied to employee IDs, and
- a short narrative on how offboarding deprovisions access (who approves, typical time-to-revoke).

Can you confirm whether you can provide a single bundle (CSV + redacted PDFs + an access timeline) by EOD Thu (2025-10-09)? Also flag any PII we should redact before transfer.

Thanks,
Jen
Senior Third-Party Risk Manager
FinBank

--
Attachment: none (initial ask)
From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: Jen Sullivan <jen.sullivan@finbank.com>

Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated personnel evidence for SOC 2 sample window

Jen —

Appreciate the clear list. We can compile a single package that includes: a CSV snapshot with training completion rows (employee id, role, course id, completion timestamp), redacted BG confirmation PDFs (name replaced with employee-id hash), and an offboarding access timeline workbook.

Quick notes / asks for TrustAssure:
- We will hash employee names to a stable id format (e.g., DK-xxxx) to preserve traceability without exposing PII.
- Background check PDFs will have date and result visible, name redacted per your guidance.
- Offboarding timeline will include ticket ids for provisioning systems (Okta, GCP IAM) and the timestamp of entitlement removal.

Laura, Marissa, Neha — can you pull the snapshots and redactions and place them in the security Drive folder linked below? I will do a final pass and send to Jen/TrustAssure. Target for upload: Thu 10/09 11:00 PT.

David
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

All —

Uploaded preliminary bundle to the Drive folder and attached the most relevant artifacts here. Redaction steps performed: employee full names replaced with stable IDs (e.g., RWF-01234), SSNs removed, and raw DOBs converted to year-only. Files included in the package: onboarding_log_snapshot_2025-10.csv, bg_check_redacted_2024-08.pdf, offboard_access_timeline_anon.xlsx.

Summary of contents (quick):
- onboarding_log_snapshot_2025-10.csv: 14,368 rows for hires/role changes; columns: employee_id, hire_date, team, manager, training_required, training_completed_at, bg_check_id.
- bg_check_redacted_2024-08.pdf: certificates for the sample cohort, redacted per David's spec.
- offboard_access_timeline_anon.xlsx: pivot-ready sheet mapping employee_id to Okta deactivation timestamp, GCP role removal, and ticket id.

I left a short narrative (DOCX) at the top level explaining the offboarding approval workflow (manager > HR > Security ops) and typical SLA (target: 2 hours for critical roles, 24 hours for standard).

Laura
Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
